## Mutation closure at head 31ffd6a: ready for owner review, not certified

**Official campaign.** `mutation-shards` run [44045848118](https://github.com/theobigand/etl-anomaly-benchmark/actions/runs/44045848118) at `51ad0794fbbe6ccaa752104abc08f4d63d4ce732`: PASS, 45 shards, controller execution proof, Linux-x86_64-glibc-2.43, `fresh_mutants=true`.

- 35,237 mutants: 34,768 killed, 463 survived, 6 timed out (a timeout is not a kill).
- 100 classified units: 97 with mutants all meet their own threshold, 3 have no function body.
- L2 100.00%, L3 98.68%, L4 98.67% raw and 99.00% adjusted. Thresholds and levels are unchanged.
- 101 exclusions in 21 units: 4 owner records of 2026-11-11 and 97 of 2026-11-17 recorded under the owner's delegation (90 with a technical argument, 7 on the owner's word). 20 units need them to pass; 362 survivors stay counted.
- Archive: `docs/thesis-remediation/evidence/final-campaign-44045848118.tar.gz`, SHA-256 `e74425daf0024fcba9e7340720988da209e698501ed3c0c25b9f487bc069052d`.

**Current at this head.** Only documentation, paper, slides and a manifest of hashes changed since the campaign commit (19 files, none is code or configuration for `claims.is_code`). Hosted CI is green on `31ffd6a`: run [44064787835](https://github.com/theobigand/etl-anomaly-benchmark/actions/runs/44064787835) (`test`, `faults`, `slides`).

**Not certified.** The release gate stays closed:
- the release workflow's DEEP job is one job of 35,237 mutants with a 180-minute limit, and the sharded deep evidence is marked `worktree_dirty` (the workflow writes into the checkout before building it), which `release.py` rejects;
- the REAL profile needs a runner that holds the research datasets, and there is none.

**Reviews.** Provenance change: two separate-context model reviews, PASS. Equivalence batch: two rounds, fixes applied. Accuracy review of the closure report: one round, fixes applied. These are model reviews, not human approval, and their texts are not archived.

**Owner decisions** (details in the report, section B): ratify or revoke the 97 delegated records, in particular the 7 on the owner's word (nine units have no slack); decide how DEEP is certified; provide a REAL runner; authorise or refuse a squash merge. Recommendation: squash, after tagging the branch history. Nothing is merged and the PR stays a draft.

Report: `docs/thesis-remediation/MUTATION_CLOSURE_2026-11-17.md`.

## Finalization at head 813256b: slides, manuscript tables, release verification

Hosted CI is green on this head (run [44164682176](https://github.com/theobigand/etl-anomaly-benchmark/actions/runs/44164682176): `test`, `faults`, `slides`). The PR stays a draft and nothing is merged.

**Release verification now runs end to end on hosted Linux.** The full `verify-release` workflow was run five times (runs 44084515801, 44088269511, 44095792721, 44113451030, 44143370017). It found seven defects that no unit test could see, each fixed at its cause with a test: the REAL preflights compared the checked-out commit with the pull request merge commit; the DEEP aggregate staged mutated source copies inside the checkout; the 8.1 MB sharded DEEP envelope exceeded the bundle member limit; the bundle carried a tracked file its allowlist refuses; the REAL profile collected modules that need PyTorch; the gate did not install the dependency set the sharded evidence binds; and one test read a file outside the mutation sandbox. `verification/release.py` is unchanged.

The last run (44143370017, `8e50b699`): FAST, FAULTS, types and tools, reproduction, **REAL on hosted Linux** (public sources, every checksum matches) and **DEEP as the 45-shard campaign** all pass. The gate reports **REJECTED for one reason**: the profiles ran different versions of pandas (3.1.1 against 3.0.6 for REAL) and pyod, and differ from the recorded lock. Not certified.

**Owner decisions** (`docs/thesis-remediation/MUTATION_CLOSURE_2026-11-17.md`, section B):
1. One dependency environment for every profile. Recommended: align on the lock (pandas 3.0.6, the only version with a numerical Cardio replay); cost: DEEP rerun and revalidation of the 97 delegated records, which bind pandas 3.1.1.
2. Ratify or revoke the 97 delegated equivalence records (`EQUIVALENCE_RATIFICATION_2026-11-17.md`; 7 on the owner's word, 2 device-dependent, 9 units with no slack).
3. Authorise or refuse the squash merge; tag the branch first.

**Slides.** Seven motion families assigned from each slide's role (`slides/deck_motion.py`), a visible light source with falloff and cast shadows, static light and shadows kept in the PDF (51 pages, 6 MB, vectors preserved), reduced motion and print respected; layout probe 0 issues in 7 font configurations.

**Manuscript.** All 23 tables classified (`MANUSCRIPT_TABLE_AUDIT_2026-11-17.md`); none removed. A derived 6 by 4 table of the best detector per type and dataset now precedes the four full matrices (checked cell by cell; `python paper/compact_view.py --check`), and a reading guide ties each detailed table to its research question. No reported value, generated block or generator changed.

**PR contents** at `8e50b699`: 4,250 files, 70.8 MB; 3,309 alert-budget runs and 100 partitions are scientific artifacts, 384 probe files and 129 notes are cited by equivalence records. Nothing further was removed.

Reviews of this work were model reviews, not human approval. To rerun the release verification, add the label `run:release-verification`; it is currently off.
